messages:
Anya: Quick Q  I hit 15h PTO unused. Policy says 8h carryover max and blackout Jan 18-22 for product freeze. My manager Carlos is traveling. Can I request a partial carryover + unpaid swap?
Carlos: I'm on a flight but approve 8h carryover. For the remaining 7h you can choose payout, unpaid, or swap for unpaid shift. Need BambooHR note or delegation recorded.
Mira (People Ops): Hi all  flow: 1) manager approval recorded in BambooHR or delegation posted here, 2) employee files CE-8800 at https://redwood.company/hr/pto-exception selecting "carryover/payout/swap", 3) Payroll must get CE ID in-thread before cutoff 2026-01-06 00:00 UTC.
Anya: Im ok with converting 4h to unpaid and taking 3h payout. Carlos, can you record delegation for approvals while you travel?
Carlos: Delegating approval to @Mira for Jan 16-26. I approve 8h carryover + 4h unpaid + 3h payout. Posting delegation here.
People Ops Bot: Delegation recorded: Carlos -> Mira (2026-01-16 to 2026-01-26).
Anya: Submitted CE-8800: "carryover 8h + unpaid 4h + payout 3h" and attached BambooHR manager approval screenshot.
Mira: Received CE-8800. Non-medical split requests are discretionary but allowed. We'll review and notify Payroll. Reminder: blackout overlaps mean employees should coordinate swaps early.
Payroll Bot: CE-8800 acknowledged. If paperwork complete before cutoff 2026-01-06 00:00 UTC payout will be processed in the next run; unpaid hours will be scheduled accordingly. Payroll will post confirmation here after processing.
Anya: Thanks  one last Q: does unpaid affect year-end bonus calculation?
Mira: Unpaid time may affect pro-rata calculations for bonus eligibility in some plans. We'll flag Finance to confirm if your role is affected. Filing DOC-3980 to clarify bonus implications for unpaid swaps.
Carlos: Thanks team. Back to flights.
People Ops Bot: Thread status: awaiting payroll finalization for CE-8800.
